mapper.select: SELECT ac_group_id FROM tb_person_ac_group WHERE person_id = #{personId}
SELECT g.biostar_ac_id FROM tb_person_ac_group pg JOIN tb_ac_group g ON g.ac_group_id = pg.ac_group_id WHERE pg.person_id = #{personId} AND g.biostar_ac_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT g.ar_code FROM tb_person_ac_group pg JOIN tb_ac_group g ON g.ac_group_id = pg.ac_group_id WHERE pg.person_id = #{personId} AND g.ar_code IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT rootg.ac_group_name FROM tb_person_ac_group pg JOIN tb_ac_group g ON g.ac_group_id = pg.ac_group_id JOIN tb_ac_group rootg ON rootg.ar_code = g.ar_code AND rootg.parent_ac_group_id IS NULL WHERE pg.person_id = #{personId} AND rootg.ac_group_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rootg.ac_group_name
